ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

4. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.

5. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.

6. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

9. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

10. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Final Circuits 4.0 Electronics 4.1 Semiconductor Theory 4.2 Semiconductor Diodes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Final Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Semiconductor Theory 4.2 Semiconductor Diodes 4.3 Transistors Page 15 of 52 1 ST and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Semiconductor Theory and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

7. C — CPU

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
